items.title: Tropical Storm Karina strengthens into a hurricane in the Pacific
items.description: Tropical Storm Karina strengthened into a hurricane in the Pacific Ocean. The storm's center was far out at sea and not threatening any land. Karina had maximum sustained winds of 80 miles per hour, making it a Category 1 hurricane. Swells from the storm were likely to cause dangerous surf conditions along parts of southwest Mexico. Elsewhere, Tropical Storm Lowell also posed no threat to land in the Pacific.

items.title: 61% of children in India exposed to one more month of heat stress due to climate change
items.description: New research reveals 61 percent of Indian children face extra heat stress annually. Climate change has doubled young children's exposure to dangerous heat levels. This exposure outpaces all other age groups, affecting millions of youngsters. Future warming scenarios project even greater heat stress for Indian children. Developing nations and younger populations bear a disproportionate burden of this threat.

items.title: COP17: New global architecture for drought resilience launched at UNCCD meet
items.author: Vishwa Mohan
items.description: The UNCCD has launched a Drought Resilience Index and Investment Facility. This initiative aims to strengthen global drought resilience by 2050. New AI tools will help countries assess and manage drought risks effectively. The facility will unlock finance for water security and land restoration projects. India advocates for proactive, technology-enabled drought preparedness over reactive relief.

items.title: Taiwan braces for Typhoon Saudel as torrential rains lash southern regions
items.author: Pranjal Pandey
items.description: As Typhoon Saudel nears Taiwan, the island braces for torrential rains that will likely exacerbate already severe flooding from a low-pressure system affecting southern areas. With schools and businesses shuttering across multiple cities, the conditions are dire. This formidable typhoon is poised to sweep past northern Taiwan, heading towards the eastern shores of China, where another storm, Narra, has already triggered extensive flooding and evacuations.
